# DeMar Transportation

> Nationwide freight transportation company serving the 48 contiguous states with dry van, reefer, flatbed, box truck, sprinter van, hazmat, FTL, LTL, 3PL, and warehousing support with 24/7 dispatch.

## About

DeMar Transportation serves shippers, brokers, and businesses moving freight across the 48 contiguous states. Headquartered in Reno, NV, DeMar operates with USDOT 4392091 and provides both motor carrier and freight broker support through its own fleet and a vetted capacity network.

## Services

- [Dry Van Shipping](https://demartransportation.com/services/dry-van/): Enclosed trailer shipping for general dry freight
- [Reefer Freight](https://demartransportation.com/services/reefer/): Temperature-controlled freight for cold chain shipments
- [Flatbed Shipping](https://demartransportation.com/services/flatbed/): Open-deck freight for machinery, lumber, steel, and oversized cargo
- [Box Truck Delivery](https://demartransportation.com/services/box-truck/): Local and regional delivery for smaller enclosed freight
- [Sprinter Van Shipping](https://demartransportation.com/services/sprinter-van/): Expedited small-shipment and dedicated cargo van delivery
- [Hazmat Freight](https://demartransportation.com/services/hazmat/): DOT-compliant hazardous materials freight support
- [Full Truckload](https://demartransportation.com/services/ftl/): Dedicated trailer capacity for larger shipments
- [Less Than Truckload](https://demartransportation.com/services/ltl/): Shared trailer space for palletized freight
- [3PL Services](https://demartransportation.com/services/3pl/): Freight management, carrier sourcing, and logistics coordination
- [Warehousing](https://demartransportation.com/services/warehousing/): Storage, cross-docking, distribution, and fulfillment coordination
